Quality Control Officer Job at Jobrole Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Jobrole Consulting Limited is a Talent Management Company that offers innovative talent and business solutions to drive performance and acceleration. Our focus is to develop and implement new ideas and strategies for Organizations to enhance their business processes and growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Quality Control Officer

Job Location: Lagos 

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Inspect construction materials, workmanship, and ongoing activities to ensure compliance with specifications.
	Conduct quality checks at different stages Of Construction to identify defects, deviations, and non- conformities and recommend corrective actions.
	Maintain accurate quality control records, inspection reports, and documentation.
	Conduct regular site inspectionsand report quality! issues to management.


Qualifications & Experience


	B.Sc. / HND in Civil Engineering, Building Technology, Quantity Surveying, or o related field.
	2-3 years of exporionce in quality control within the construction industry.
	Good knowledge of construction materials, processes, and quality standards.
	Strog attention to detai problem-solving skills.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs and Portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "IT Officer",
  "description": "Catalyst Path Consulting is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below:

Job Position: IT Officer

Job Location: Apapa, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	We are seeking a proactive and technically competent IT Officer to manage and support the organisation&rsquo;s IT infrastructure, systems, hardware, software, and end-user technology needs.
	The successful candidate will ensure reliable day-to-day IT operations and provide timely technical support to employees.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide first- and second-level technical support to staff and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
	Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computers, printers, servers, network devices, and other IT equipment.
	Manage user accounts, access permissions, email systems, and other business applications.
	Monitor network performance, internet connectivity, and IT infrastructure.
	Maintain IT asset registers and ensure proper deployment, tracking, and maintenance of equipment.
	Perform regular system updates, backups, antivirus checks, and basic cybersecurity controls.
	Diagnose and resolve technical issues promptly, escalating complex problems when necessary.
	Support the implementation and maintenance of IT policies, procedures, and security standards.
	Liaise with internet service providers, software vendors, and other IT service providers when required.
	Maintain accurate records of IT incidents, repairs, configurations, and maintenance activities.
	Assist with IT projects, system upgrades, and technology improvements.
	Educate staff on basic IT security, systems usage, and best practices.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
	2&ndash;4 years of relevant IT support/administration experience.
	Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365, hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
	Working knowledge of LAN/WAN, routers, switches, Wi-Fi, printers, and basic network security.
	Familiarity with IT asset management, backups, antivirus solutions, and user access management.
	Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and respond effectively to urgent technical issues.
	Experience in a structured corporate, logistics, manufacturing, or industrial environment will be an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Technical troubleshooting
	Network and systems support
	Cybersecurity awareness
	IT asset management
	Problem-solving
	Attention to detail
	Customer service orientation
	Communication and teamwork
	Ability to work under pressure.


Salary
N400,000 - N450,000 gross monthly, depending on experience and suitability for the role.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: isaac.samuel@anrml.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Candidates based in or able to commute conveniently to Apapa, Lagos are preferred.",

IT Officer Job at Catalyst Path Consulting




        
    

        
        Catalyst Path Consulting is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below:

Job Position: IT Officer

Job Location: Apapa, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	We are seeking a proactive and technically competent IT Officer to manage and support the organisation’s IT infrastructure, systems, hardware, software, and end-user technology needs.
	The successful candidate will ensure reliable day-to-day IT operations and provide timely technical support to employees.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Provide first- and second-level technical support to staff and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
	Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computers, printers, servers, network devices, and other IT equipment.
	Manage user accounts, access permissions, email systems, and other business applications.
	Monitor network performance, internet connectivity, and IT infrastructure.
	Maintain IT asset registers and ensure proper deployment, tracking, and maintenance of equipment.
	Perform regular system updates, backups, antivirus checks, and basic cybersecurity controls.
	Diagnose and resolve technical issues promptly, escalating complex problems when necessary.
	Support the implementation and maintenance of IT policies, procedures, and security standards.
	Liaise with internet service providers, software vendors, and other IT service providers when required.
	Maintain accurate records of IT incidents, repairs, configurations, and maintenance activities.
	Assist with IT projects, system upgrades, and technology improvements.
	Educate staff on basic IT security, systems usage, and best practices.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
	2–4 years of relevant IT support/administration experience.
	Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365, hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
	Working knowledge of LAN/WAN, routers, switches, Wi-Fi, printers, and basic network security.
	Familiarity with IT asset management, backups, antivirus solutions, and user access management.
	Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and respond effectively to urgent technical issues.
	Experience in a structured corporate, logistics, manufacturing, or industrial environment will be an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Technical troubleshooting
	Network and systems support
	Cybersecurity awareness
	IT asset management
	Problem-solving
	Attention to detail
	Customer service orientation
	Communication and teamwork
	Ability to work under pressure.


Salary
N400,000 - N450,000 gross monthly, depending on experience and suitability for the role.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Candidates based in or able to commute conveniently to Apapa, Lagos are preferred.

title: Job Openings at Agrinova Limited
content:
Agrinova Limited - We are into allocating land to clients and planting palm fruit.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Human Resources Officer 

Job Location: Lagos  
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Human Resources Officer with experience of end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, employee records, documentation, payroll management and general HR processes.
	The ideal candidate should have strong administrative skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate and confidential employee information.


Job Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	2 – 4 years of experience in Human Resources.
	End to end recruitment process.
	Proficiency in HRIS Systems and Microsoft / google work suite.
	Basic Knowledge of HR Policies, Employment Law and Labour Regulations.
	Strong Communication and Interpersonal abilities.
	High Level of Integrity with the ability to handle confidential information discreetly.
	Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail.
	Proactive, Supportive, and a team-oriented mindset.


Application Closing Date: 20th September, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified Candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Human Resources Officer” as the subject of the mail.

 

2.) IT Support Officer 

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a skilled IT Support Officer to manage and maintain IT systems, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.


Requirements


	HND/BSc in Computer Science or related field
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in IT Support
	Knowledge of hardware, software, and network systems
	Ability to create and manage a website
	Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
	Must reside in or around Sangotedo.


Application Closing Date: 25th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send CVs to [email protected] using “IT Support Officer” as the subject of the email.

Note: Applicants must reside within or around the Sangotedo axis.

 

3.) Social Media Manager

Job Location: Abraham Adesanya, Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a creative and results-driven NYSC Corper, that will be managing our brand's presence across social media platforms.
	The ideal candidate will create engaging content, grow online communities, execute social media campaigns, and analyse performance to strengthen brand awareness and support business objectives.


Requirements


	HND / BSc in Mass Communication, theatre art, (or equivalent) to related field.
	Minimum of 1 year of experience in social media
	Must be NYSC Corp member
	Must reside in or around Abraham Adesanya
	Creativity and attention to detail.
	Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
	Develop, plan, and execute social media content calendars across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, and YouTube.
	Create engaging posts, captions, reels, stories, and other multimedia content aligned with the brand voice.
	Manage social media campaigns to drive engagement, traffic, and lead generation.
	Stay updated on industry trends, platform updates, and emerging social media best practices.
	Collaborate with designers, content writers, and marketing teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
	Monitor competitor activities and recommend strategies to improve brand visibility.
	Ensure all content complies with brand guidelines and organizational policies.


Application Closing Date: 20th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using “Social Media Manager” as the subject of the mail.
